title: 5-Day Exploring Southern Laos
headline: The complete south: plateau, temples and two nights on the Mekong
price_note: From $XX per person — Standard accommodation. Comfort upgrades available.
dream: Five days give the region room to breathe. After the Bolaven and Champasak, you spend two nights in the 4000 Islands instead of rushing through them. The last morning is Khone Phapheng, then either Pakse or the Cambodia border.
highlights: Full Bolaven day with waterfalls, coffee and Phu Krateh
Champasak by boat + Vat Phou + Nang Sida
Tomo, Phou Asa and a Mekong cruise to Don Khone
Full island day: Li Phi, colonial remains, Don Loppadi
Two nights on the islands + flexible end point

itinerary.title: Bolaven Plateau
itinerary.body: Tad Fane, Tad Yuang, Jhai Coffee, Phu Krateh, overnight Pakse. Meals: Lunch / Dinner.

itinerary.title: Pakse to Champasak
itinerary.body: Boat, Nang Sida, Vat Phou, Champasak overnight. Meals: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner.

itinerary.title: Champasak to the 4,000 Islands
itinerary.body: Tomo, Phou Asa, boat via Don Som to Don Khone. Meals: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner.

itinerary.title: Full day in the 4,000 Islands
itinerary.body: Li Phi, Khonepasoi, French remains, Don Loppadi, overnight Don Khone. Meals: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner.

itinerary.title: Khone Phapheng then border or Pakse
itinerary.body: Khone Phapheng, then Nong Nok Khiene border or Pakse. Meals: Breakfast / Lunch.

included: 4 nights accommodation + meals as mentioned + entrance fees + water
excluded: Guide (on request), extra meals, tips, insurance, personal expenses, optional activities
upgrades: Superior / comfort hotels in Pakse, Champasak and on Don Khone
Palateu shadow puppet theatre in Champasak (seasonal)
Zipline at Tad Fane or Li Phi
End the tour at the Cambodia border instead of Pakse
